worldcombat.skill.transform.summary: Temporarily copy an opponent’s combat profile: a Pokémon’s moves, stats, types and Ability, or a non-Pokémon’s attack, movement and defences.
worldcombat.skill.transform.use.0: Borrow a foe's whole move set and stats for a stretch
worldcombat.skill.transform.use.1: Take a foe's high-attack or high-defence shape
worldcombat.skill.transform.use.2: Switch to a completely different playstyle once you know the foe
Against a Pokémon, copy its moves, five combat stats, types and Ability for %1$s. Keep your own health, level and appearance.
Reach: %1$s blocks. Cannot copy an already transformed target.
Preparation %1$s, recovery %2$s, cooldown %3$s. Expiry or cleansing restores your own combat properties.
worldcombat.skill.transform.dwell.0: Deep: shape x1.35, cooldown x1.2 — keeps the form longer, transforms less often.
worldcombat.skill.transform.dwell.1: Light: shape x0.75, cooldown x0.8 — transforms often, but each one is short.
worldcombat.skill.transform.timing: Cast on a single enemy: after %2$s of preparation it spends %4$s PP; the recovery is %3$s, the cooldown %5$s from commit, and the current range %1$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.transform.preference.d: On (deep): shape x1.35, cooldown x1.2. Off (light): shape x0.75, cooldown x0.8. Trade how long the form lasts for how often you can change.
worldcombat.skill.transform.preference.a: The partner only considers transforming while a target is this close; smaller keeps it for melee, larger chases out to copy.
Prefer forms whose strongest move reaches this power. Weaker forms remain available for their types, stats, abilities and moves.
When on, the partner will also leave its post to transform.
worldcombat.skill.transform.world: Against a non-Pokémon, copy its current native attack damage, movement speed, armour, armour toughness and knockback resistance for %1$s. Keep your own health, moves and appearance. Expiry or cleansing restores your properties; equipment and other effects still apply.
